title: Unit Event — Competitive Fire! — Episode7 As Rivals

meta.Event Outline: When Vivid BAD SQUAD go for a meal with Ken, Taiga and the twins before their return to Japan, an unexpected reunion sparks a newfound fire in An.

rows.Line: New York City - Park

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Dad started teaching Becky and me how to sing when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: How to be better than everyone else. How to be the most marketable.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: It was all that, all the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, that's...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Strictly speaking, he didn't force us.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
But...How do I put this?
It was like we couldn't really see any other option... There was always that anxiety pressing on us.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: He was only nice to us because he saw us as his prized “products”.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Elena...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
You know the truth now, Becky.
There's nothing he won't stoop to to get what he wants.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: He chews up other people's dreams and spits them out when he's done using them. And he always smiled in front of us... Like nothing at all was wrong.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: He tries to keep it all under the table, but when I think about how many musicians' careers he's ruined I...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Sorry. I keep getting all worked up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that's okay. But are you sure about this? You don't have to continue if you don't...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
I'm fine!
I just get so angry whenever I think about what happened back then.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
I'm angry at him...
And myself, for giving up and just doing as I was told.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Elena...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Back then, to us, singing was something that we just had to do...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: To get praised by our dad and the other grown-ups around us. We never even really thought about whether we liked it or not.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Everything changed when we heard RADder sing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When you heard RADder?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We met RADder for the first time at the venue for a music event.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We were just there because of our dad's work, so we didn't really have much to do.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Elena and I ended up sneaking out of the green room.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Then, we got lost and almost started to cry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, were you two okay?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
See, RADder happened to be at that event too.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Nagi ran into us by chance and looked after us. We met Taiga and Ken then too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, that was when you heard them sing?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Yes. We asked our dad, and he got us into the invited guests section.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: And we were totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: That was the first time we'd ever seen a group of adults having so much fun as they sang.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: We realized that songs need to come from the heart...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Music isn't something you do for praise. Not for money or fame, either.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Music is something purer than that. And they're the ones who taught us.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Yeah... When we heard them sing, that's when we realized.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We wanted to learn how to sing from our hearts...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: After that, every time RADder came over to the US, we went to go see them in secret.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: That was also around the time when Slade and Ceddy started letting us practice with them.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: That takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Me too. You two even began learning Japanese because you wanted to talk to Nagi and the others in their own language.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yeah! Looking back, Nagi and her team really did teach us a lot.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: On the other hand, our dad really didn't react well when he learned that we were learning how to sing from RADder.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because it wasn't the music he wanted you two to sing?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Exactly. And it's true, as time went on, we were more and more drawn to RADder's music...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: And we began to want to sing more freely.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We wanted to sing like them. With heart and passion.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: So we told the old man we wanted more freedom, and to stay away from us, basically.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, did he end up agreeing to that?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Well, since then, he hasn't tried to make us do anything...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But the way he pivoted so quickly did bother us a little.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
I mean, he hates wasting time.
He probably wrote us off the second he realized that we weren't worth it.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yeah, that's possible!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: We knew you were DG's daughters, but this is the first time we're hearing any of the rest.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: We weren't trying to hide it. We just didn't want him going anywhere near you two...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: God only knows what's going through his head, so I'd prefer to keep on staying far away from him.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
But that's easier said than done...
If we're going to pursue music, then it's going to be hard to avoid him.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: We may run into him again by happenstance like today. Or people might start spreading rumors about us.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: I know, right? Like we're nepo babies, or he's fixing our competitions or stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The reason why those two sounded so angry and hurt while they sang was...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Because of their past.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Seeing the grown-ups around you make all these decisions without asking for your opinion must've been really hard...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why was I the only one who didn't know something this important?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's different from what happened to me, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for telling us all this, you two.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: No, thanks for listening.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: And we're really sorry about dragging you all into this mess...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, Becky, you two have done nothing wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're just rumors, so all you need to do is ignore them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Also...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I sorta understand how you two feel.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, you know... We're all gonna be fine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't care what anyone says about you two, Elena. And if I do hear anything, I'll shut them right up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, you can count on us, as your rivals!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Thanks, rivals.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But we aren't about to let you guys win, so be prepared!
